newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Denmark sees 1996 inflation as 2.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Denmark sees 1996 inflation as 2.1 pct.

text.p: Denmark's Economy Ministry on Tuesday forecast a consumer price rise of 2.1 percent in 1996 and 2.3 percent in both 1997 and 1998, calculated by a domestic formula rather than the European Union method.

The figures compared with the ministry's previous forecast -- in October -- of 2.1 percent inflation for 1996 and 2.3 percent for 1997. In 1995 prices rose by 2.1 percent. The ministry did not make any CPI forecasts using the EU method.
October 1996 prices logged by the National Statistics Office rose 2.4 percent year-on-year using the domestic formula and 2.6 percent by the EU method.
